title: A First Visit to the Pool
context: Grace 和工作人员 Tom 在游泳池入口讨论泳道与储物安排。本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，题目为原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: I'm visiting this pool for the first time. Where can I swim slowly?
dialogue.zh: 我是第一次来这个游泳池。哪里适合慢游？

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.en: The lane closest to the wall is for slower swimmers this afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 今天下午靠墙的泳道供游得较慢的人使用。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Thanks. Is there a place to put my bag?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。有地方放我的包吗？

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.en: Yes, there are lockers in the changing room.

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Do I need to bring a lock?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.en: For these lockers, yes. We also sell simple locks at the desk.
dialogue.zh: 这些柜子需要。我们柜台也卖简单的锁。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: I brought one, so that works. Where are the showers?
dialogue.zh: 我带了一把，那就没问题。淋浴间在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.en: They're just past the lockers, on your left.

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: And when does the pool close today?
dialogue.zh: 那今天游泳池什么时候关闭？

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.en: The pool closes at eight tonight, and the changing room closes at eight thirty.
dialogue.zh: 今晚泳池八点关闭，更衣室八点半关闭。

dialogue.speaker: Grace
dialogue.en: Great. I'll have plenty of time for a short swim.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我有充足的时间游一会儿。

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.en: Enjoy your swim. Let me know if you need anything else.
dialogue.zh: 祝你游得愉快。需要别的帮助请告诉我。

expressions.example: I'm visiting this town for the first time.
Choose the chair closest to the door.
The changing room is down the hall.
The cafe is just past the bank.
We have plenty of time before lunch.

pronunciation: swim 的开头依次发 /s/、/w/；lockers 重读第一音节，词尾 r 用美式卷舌音。

practice.title: Part 1 · Swimming
practice.answer: Yes, I enjoy a slow swim when I have time. It helps me relax, and I like being in the water.

practice.title: Part 2 · A place to exercise
practice.prompt: Describe a place where you exercise. Say where it is, what you do there, and why you like it.
practice.answer: I sometimes go to a swimming pool near my home. I usually visit in the early evening and swim slowly for a while. Before I get into the water, I put my bag in a locker and use the shower. The pool has several lanes, so I choose one that suits my speed. I like the place because it is bright and I can relax after a busy day. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Exercise facilities
practice.prompt: How can exercise facilities welcome people with different abilities?
practice.answer: They can offer clear information about activities and provide spaces for different speeds. Friendly staff can also help visitors find an activity that feels comfortable for them.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读后询问适合自己的泳道、储物柜和当天的关闭时间。
practice.answer: Where can I swim slowly? Is there a locker for my bag? What time does the pool close today?
